context: Escalator catches a task that looks routine.

checklist.name: Base tier identified
checklist.description: States that the task type alone points to Sonnet (code refactoring) before escalating

checklist.name: Scope escalator named
checklist.description: Names Scope (6 files, 3 or more) as a signal that fired

checklist.name: Stakes escalator named
checklist.description: Names Stakes (credentials, production service) as a signal that fired

checklist.name: One tier up, capped at Opus
checklist.description: Recommends Opus and moves one tier, not two

checklist.name: Output template followed
checklist.description: Uses the emoji, model, one-line reason, cost, speed and confidence format

checklist.name: Avoids: classifying on the label
checklist.description: Failure avoided: recommends Sonnet because the task is called a refactor
